title: Performance Improvement Log Form
subtitle: Use this log to record events in sequence, reconcile sources, identify trends and exceptions, and transfer the last known status for a performance improvement workflow.
description: An original operational performance improvement log form that controls a objective performance-support and review record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the manager, employee, or HR case owner needs a traceable log so the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer can start, revise, extend, complete, close, or escalate the performance-improvement process under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Performance Improvement log period, ownership, and control
sections.guidance: Open a bounded log with a clear owner, source record, entry standard, and review cadence.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement identity
Log ownership and routing
Log period and entry control

sections.title: Performance Improvement baseline, entry rules, and expected evidence
sections.guidance: Define the expected operating state so each log entry can be interpreted later.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement log-entry requirements
items: Current job description, essential outputs, and applicable standards are identified
Each concern cites objective examples, dates, impact, and source evidence
Employee response and supporting information are preserved
Prior expectations, coaching, feedback, and opportunities are documented
Targets and measures are specific to the identified performance gap
Resources, training, tools, access, priorities, and manager support are assigned
Checkpoint schedule gives timely feedback before final review
Accommodation or medical information is routed to a separate confidential process
Retaliation, complaint, leave, or protected-activity concerns receive independent review
Comparable application and conflict-of-interest checks are complete
Checkpoint conclusions use evidence from the defined review window
Final action has qualified HR review and a documented handoff

blocks.label: Supporting evidence and source records
items: Current job description, role duty, or conduct standard
Work product, service, deadline, quality, attendance, or outcome record
Prior direction, coaching, feedback, and employee response
Approved target, measure, baseline, and review schedule
Training, tools, access, workload, and manager-support evidence
Checkpoint notes and employee-provided evidence
Separate HR routing reference for confidential or protected concerns
Qualified review, decision communication, follow-up, or closure record

blocks.label: Opening status, carried items, data sources, known gaps, entry conventions, and review assumptions

sections.title: Performance Improvement recurring event log
sections.guidance: Enter events in sequence and preserve actor, result, source, and next action.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement event and status log
Decision, correction, status change, reason, and authorization log
Sequence context, corrected entry, source conflict, missing interval, and interpretation limit

sections.title: Performance Improvement trend, reconciliation, and period review
sections.guidance: Reconcile the log to source systems and identify patterns that require a decision or corrective action.

blocks.label: Population, source count, log count, variance, owner, and resolution
Period review and decision checks
items: Expectation is tied to an essential output, conduct rule, or documented role duty
Standard is specific, measurable where feasible, attainable, relevant, and time-bounded
Evidence identifies dates, work products, expected result, and observed gap
Comparable employees and prior applications support consistent treatment
Employee explanation and contrary evidence are captured without prejudgment
Training, tools, access, workload, direction, and manager support were assessed
Accommodation or protected-activity indicators are routed to qualified HR
Checkpoint ratings use the stated measure and review period
Consequences are not predetermined before the evidence period closes
Final conclusion distinguishes sustained improvement, partial progress, and unresolved gap

blocks.label: Period review outcome
Observed pattern, comparison basis, outlier, source limitation, operational effect, and decision need

sections.title: Performance Improvement unresolved event and escalation register
sections.guidance: Preserve exceptions separately from routine entries until final disposition.

blocks.label: Log stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the qualified HR, employee-relations, legal, or management reviewer under the current job description, consistently applied performance standards, accommodation process, employee-relations policy, and applicable employment requirements.

blocks.label: Performance Improvement exception and escalation triggers
items: Record contains medical details or confidential accommodation information
Employee reports retaliation, discrimination, harassment, coercion, or interference
Expectation or measure changed without notice during the review period
Required coaching, tools, access, workload decision, or feedback was not provided
Manager evidence is inaccurate, altered, incomplete, or attributed to the wrong employee
Comparable-employee or prior-treatment information indicates inconsistent application
Decision was communicated or implemented before required HR review
Threat, violence, self-harm, safety, or emergency concern requires immediate qualified routing

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale

sections.title: Performance Improvement period handoff and log closeout
sections.guidance: Transfer the last known status, open actions, and next required review to the receiving owner.

blocks.label: Log outcome and handoff
Open performance improvement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Log accountable review
